title: Herzliches Beileid
desc: A queue, and the same two words forty times
setting: The door of a church on a Tuesday afternoon, four hundred people, and rain that nobody is putting an umbrella up against.

options.feedback: The formula, and the hand, one second longer. Nothing else is needed and nothing else is wanted.

options.es: Sie war ein besonderer Mensch für mich.
options.en: She was a special person to me.
options.feedback: True, and it asks her for a reply she has already given two hundred times today.

options.es: Ich weiss, wie Sie sich fühlen.
options.feedback: You do not, and it is the one sentence that is wrong in every language.
The whole answer. Everybody here places you with it immediately.
Also true, and it makes him work out where you fit. Neighbour is the word they use.
Modesty that makes the other person carry it. She talked about you.
He lived below her for eleven years. He lost something as well and he just told you so.
Not wrong. It just takes the thing he offered you and keeps it.
True and it fills the space he left for the two of you.

steps.speaker: Vreni
steps.es: Wenn Sie etwas brauchen, melden Sie sich.
steps.en: If you need anything, get in touch.

options.es: Und wenn ich etwas machen kann, sagen Sie es.
options.en: And if I can do anything, tell me.
options.feedback: Only say it if you mean it, because she will come back to you on it. Two days later she does.
Fine, and it ends the exchange one step early.

options.es: Sie haben jetzt genug zu tun.
options.en: You have enough to do now.
options.feedback: Meant kindly. It also decides for her what she can manage.
